ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within $\triangle ABC$, $AD$ is the angle bisector of $\angle BAC$, $BE$ is the altitude from B to side $AC$, and $AD$ and $BE$ intersect at point $O$. If $\angle AOE=70^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle ABE$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $BE$ is the altitude on side $AC$,\\
it follows that $\angle AEB=90^\circ$.\\
Therefore, $\angle OAE=90^\circ-\angle AOE=20^\circ$.\\
Since $AD$ is the angle bisector of $\angle BAC$,\\
it follows that $\angle BAC=2\angle OAE=40^\circ$.\\
Therefore, $\angle ABE=90^\circ-\angle BAC=\boxed{50^\circ}$.
